meta.title: Holiday Guide
meta.subtitle: Shop Local For Gifts And More

businesses.name: Stratford Hall Historic Preserve
businesses.blurb: The gift shop carries sweaters, books, kitchenware and stuffed animals with real historic character, plus custom gift baskets of premium jams, nuts, handmade ornaments, Edwards petite country ham and Stratford Hall grits milled on site in the 1738 gristmill.

businesses.name: WPA Bakery
businesses.blurb: Holiday desserts including a pumpkin-caramel swirl cheesecake, with most selections adaptable to gluten-free and vegan diets. Order guides post the first week of November and December — call or email to place an order.

businesses.name: World of Mirth
businesses.blurb: Jellycat's Letter to Santa is a polar explorer on a quest for the Northern Lights, camera and flask of cocoa at the ready. Any message to Santa gets her stamp of approval.

businesses.name: Whitley's Peanut Factory
businesses.blurb: Nearly 40 years of handcrafted snacks and treats, serving Richmond since 2017. Small-batch Virginia peanuts, confections and mixes, with custom assortments for gifting or stocking up for gatherings.
